newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to offer low-cost loans to constructions.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to offer low-cost loans to constructions.

text.p: Taiwan cabinet's Development Fund said on Friday it had decided to include domestic construction companies in its low-cost loan plan to strengthen their competitiveness and help boost the property market.

The Development Fund already has a fund totalling some T$10 billion to be used for low-cost loans to local manufacturers, farming industry and business for equipment purchases, it said in a statement.
The Development Fund now would include construction firms in the loan plan, offering loans with an annual loan rate of 6.450-6.575 percent, the statement said.
Each construction firm can apply for up to T$400 million worth of loans, the Development Fund said.
The loans would have a seven-year term but could be extended by an additional three years, it said.
